verdict.rationale: The only native background automation in the evidence is scheduled automatic full exports. The AI assistant can plan multi-step work, but it proposes creates and updates for the user to approve, so it does not act autonomously. Running your own autonomous automations requires building an external agent or bot against the REST API or MCP. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/workflow engine (triggers, schedules, actions on content), autonomous AI agents that act without approval, background execution beyond exports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
